About

Hey, I'm Akhil.

A creative graphic designer and VFX artist who learns fast and works well both in a team and alone. I trained in visual effects, motion graphics and rotoscopy, and I look for work where thinking out of the box is the job.

I have designed for agencies, EV charging, food, retail and automotive brands in Bengaluru, Kerala and Dubai. Today I design and edit for Vesla Group in Dubai: vehicle promotions, showroom displays, brochures, banners, social creatives and showcase reels for new arrivals and offers. I work directly with clients and teams, and I keep every piece consistent with the brand, from a business card to a van wrap.

How a design goes from brief to hand-off

  1. Brief

    Understand the goal, the audience and where the design will be used.

  2. Research

    Look at the brand guidelines, competitors and references.

  3. Concept

    Sketch directions and agree on one with the client.

  4. Design

    Build it in Illustrator, Photoshop or After Effects.

  5. Refine

    Take feedback and polish layout, type and colour.

  6. Deliver

    Hand off print-ready and platform-ready files on time.
